verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say role changes and departures automatically update access, permissions and groups. Dynamic rules provision accounts as roles change, and hires and offboardings trigger downstream flows such as device ordering and retrieval. Custom workflows and cross-system workflow automation are also claimed, so the core event-driven lifecycle choreography is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a no-code workflow builder and its triggers, per-app action detail, and any independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).
